_note: Configuration for the weekly AFA job scraper Cloud Function.

_docs.drive_folder_id: The ID of the shared Google Drive folder where the master Excel file is stored. Share this folder with the service account email.
_docs.master_file_name: The filename of the master Excel workbook stored in the Drive folder.
_docs.groups: Array of job title groups. Each group becomes a sheet in the Excel workbook. Each title in 'titles' is queried separately against the AFA API.
_docs.tuning: The AFA 'was' parameter ANDs all words: 'radar zzzz' returns 0, 'radar' returns 164. More words = fewer, more precise hits. Counts in _expected_hits are 45-day lookbacks verified 2026-09-29 and will drift.
_docs.avoid: Do NOT add bare German nouns: 'wahrnehmung' (2353 hits, mostly legal 'Wahrnehmung von Aufgaben'), 'regelung' (2560), 'sensorik' (1267), 'robotik' (846), 'embedded software' (816), 'bildverarbeitung' (186). They swamp a sheet with unrelated roles. Also skip 'autonomes fahren' (93 hits, top results are Testfahrer/Fahrer) and 'fahrerassistenzsysteme' (59 hits, 58% Kfz-Mechatroniker).

_expected_hits._comment: Approximate per-group totals from a 45-day window; overlap inside a group is de-duplicated by refnr.
